name: OpenClaw Wrapper
description: Execute an OpenClaw automation flow with enforced scope boundaries and output verification.

flow_id.description: Identifier of the OpenClaw flow to execute

scope.description: Permission scope for the flow execution

steps.description: Verify the requested scope is allowed for the given flow and current user
Execute the OpenClaw flow within the validated scope boundary
Validate the flow output conforms to the declared schema and scope constraints

constraints: Flow execution is strictly bounded by the declared scope (read, write, or admin)
All flow outputs must pass schema validation before the recipe completes
Runaway or long-running flows are terminated after the configured timeout
invariants: No scope escalation beyond the declared level is possible during execution
Flow outputs that fail verification block the recipe from reporting success
No side effects outside the declared scope boundary are permitted
